name: Bazaar
fix_description: In exitPool, add require(sender == msg.sender) to prevent callers from specifying arbitrary sender addresses. Currently anyone can pass any address as sender to exit the pool on behalf of other users without authorization, draining their LP positions.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a single-call exploit: it directly invokes exitPool on the vulnerable vault using another holder as the sender, indicating an obvious missing authorization/access-control issue. It requires little protocol-specific complexity, no flash loans or multi-step state manipulation, and the exploit logic is very short and straightforward.
